name: Harbour Bridge, CBD end: getting on and off it, and the bridge itself

ways.why: The Clarence St ramp is the bridge's tidal-flow lane: northbound except weekday mornings (OSM's note on way 870649960). The game has no morning, and the video drives up it northbound at midday (0:33-0:51). As reversible it was built two-way: traffic both ways on a 9 m ramp

The Cahill loop up to the bridge northbound runs in a cutting with sheer sandstone walls both sides (ref/details/1.png). As the open end of the tunnel it comes out of, the game draws it that way; on the ground it was a graded slope, with buildings standing over the road's edge

The bus lane between the pylons, lane 7 (ref/details/4.png: the bus lane beside the Cahill's lane through the pylon). OSM keeps all but buses off it (access=no), and the build leaves out what cars can't drive, so the deck had a hole where it is. Taken in as a road, painted as a bus lane
